اكتئب (form VIII)
# اُكْتُئِبَ (uktuʔiba) /uk.tu.ʔi.ba/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِكْتَأَبَ (iktaʔaba)
# اِكْتَئِبْ (iktaʔib) /ik.ta.ʔib/: second-person masculine singular imperative of اِكْتَأَبَ (iktaʔaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
